project_goal: Design an amphiphilic binary poly(amino acid) system for tumor-vaccine antigen delivery.

architecture.template: P(L-X)-b-P(D-Lys) after Stage 1 functional-block identity and Lys-chirality resolution
architecture.B_role: basic/cationic functional block for antigen/protein interaction and immune-relevant material behavior
architecture.X_role: assembly/material-property block selected from the 17 remaining canonical amino-acid identities; V1 does not vary X chirality

candidate_universe.combination_boundary: The chemistry identity space is constrained by role. V1 does not allow arbitrary 20x20 pairing.
candidate_universe.chirality_boundary: Only Lys chirality is resolved after functional identity selection. The 17 X candidates are treated in their natural L form; Arg/His chirality is not explored in V1.

preselected_candidates.name: Lysine
preselected_candidates.chemical_basis: basic, hydrophilic and predominantly cationic near physiological pH

preselected_candidates.name: Arginine
preselected_candidates.chemical_basis: strongly basic, hydrophilic and strongly cationic over the physiological pH range

preselected_candidates.name: Histidine
preselected_candidates.chemical_basis: hydrophilic, weakly basic and pH-responsive, with increased protonation under acidic conditions

important_constraints: Preselection does not rank K, R or H.
Functional identity is selected from K/R/H using traceable literature evidence.
After Lys is selected, only Lys chirality is resolved; D-Lys is then frozen for downstream V1 evaluation.
No other amino-acid chirality is explored in V1.
The assembly/material-property block X is selected only from the 17 canonical identities excluding K/R/H.
Known K-F / K-L / K-Q experimental outcomes must not be used to tune AP/CPP/solubility model features, thresholds or ranking rules.

current_module.goal: Select K/R/H functional identity; if K is selected, resolve L-Lys vs D-Lys and freeze D-Lys before X screening.
current_module.deferred_to_assembly_block_module: Evaluate the 17 natural-L X identities with low-fidelity priors/proxies and direct physicochemical descriptors.

expected_output.primary_hydrophilic_block: one candidate if evidence supports a primary choice
